principle_violations.reason: Adding a new payment method requires modifying the existing structure by adding another class inheriting from PaymentProcessor and overriding pay. This violates the principle since the code should be extendable without altering existing code.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the pay method to use a strategy pattern where payment functionalities can dynamically be added at runtime by injecting a payment strategy into the PaymentProcessor.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Implementing the recommended changes will make the codebase adhere to the Open/Closed Principle by introducing a strategy-based design for payment processing.
